# CG-API-006: operationId changed

The same operation has a different operationId.

**Why it matters:** operationId is a code-generation identity, not a wire identity.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `operation.operationIdChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | yes |

## Message

> operationId of {operation} changed from "{from}" to "{to}".
>
> The wire contract is unchanged, but generated SDK method names derived from operationId change.
>
> **Fix:** Keep operationIds stable, or treat SDK regeneration as a breaking release for SDK users.

## Options

Set in `.contractguard.yaml` under `rules.overrides.CG-API-006.options`.

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sdkSensitive` | boolean | `false` | Treat operationId changes as potentially breaking because generated SDK method names change. |

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: getUser → fetchUser

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {operationId: fetchUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. operationId of GET /a changed from "getUser" to "fetchUser".

### Fires: sdkSensitive option

With options: `{"overrides":{"CG-API-006":{"options":{"sdkSensitive":true}}}}`

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {operationId: fetchUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. operationId of GET /a changed from "getUser" to "fetchUser".

### Does not fire: operationId added where none existed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {operationId: x, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-006
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-006: { severity: low }
```
